digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: Tickets-store pack size exceeds CI verification gate limit (131431 KiB > 131072 KiB), causing stale-based changes to fail the pack-size step, requiring proactive history repack/gc to add headroom and reduce filtered pack size below 128 MiB.

History rewrite via git fast-export/filter/fast-import must strip spent .bridge_state history (~1 GiB) while dynamically re-adding current .bridge_state tree, followed by separate repack/gc compaction to release unreachable history disk bytes.

Coordinated quiet-window maintenance requires zero active sessions, stopped rebar-mcp servers, disabled workflows/timers/LaunchAgents, verified off-repo rollback bundles before and after the prerequisite repair (ticket 30d3), exact force-with-lease publication, identity equivalence validation, and deterministic first post-rewrite write with opportunistic enrichment disabled.

Tickets branch identity summary and (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets must remain byte-identical across rewrite (ignoring commit SHAs), tree/commit/merge counts unchanged, fresh unfiltered clone ≤150 MiB, old-tip ancestry absent after publication, and no ref fetched by default clone retains old tip as ancestor.

rebar.toml identity.enforce_since re-pin via Gerrit review must land as the deterministic sole canonical sequence (CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, code-review-to-work link, reciprocal link) with <1 MiB post-rewrite incremental growth and old-tip ancestry remaining false.

Rollback is an explicit second quiet window restoring the pre-rewrite off-repo bundle, recovering old tip via exact force-with-lease, reverting identity.enforce_since through Gerrit, and requiring identity multiset equivalence before writers resume, with the same temporary opportunistic enrichment guard applied.
